head_resolution.note: Do not store the containing commit as authoritative_head: that would be self-referential. Resolve the current authoritative branch ref from GitHub before every development action.

development_validation.note: The knowledge-bootstrap head passed hosted development validation and proved the strict gate fails only for the six known open blockers. Product-development commits after that head require fresh validation.

risk_defect_gate.note: The strict gate must fail closed until release blockers are resolved with permanent executable coverage.

next_exact_goal.description: Implement the audited 4.17.9 multi-Hub convergence as one coherent change set: target-driven recovery, identity-preserving rebind, global/per-instance Hub-input reachability, and fresh full activation validation at commit boundaries; add permanent executable coverage for audit scenarios A01-A20 before clearing blockers.

Resolve authoritative_branch HEAD live from GitHub and treat the remote branch as authoritative.
